jobs.title: Vice President, Corporate Finance
jobs.description:
Inspirational, innovative and entrepreneurial - this is how we describe our empowered teams. Combine your passion with purpose and join a firm and team that is growing and culture that is thriving in the face of change.

Make an impact with our Corporate Finance team as a Vice President. This diverse team of professionals helps maximize our clients’ potential, enabling them to seize opportunities as they emerge within an evolving business landscape. As a trusted advisor, you’ll provide innovative solutions that support clients’ divestiture, financing, and acquisition objectives.

MNP is proudly Canadian. Providing business strategies and solutions, we are a leading national accounting, tax, and business advisory firm in Canada. Entrepreneurial to our core, our talented team members transcend obstacles into opportunities and continue to transform mid-market business practices.

Responsibilities

Lead the proposal, planning and execution of corporate finance engagements, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and capital-raising transactions.
Manage end-to-end M&A processes, including market research, target identification, buyer outreach, negotiations, and transaction execution.
Lead the delivery of private placement and syndication of financing, including debt, junior capital, and equity.
Conduct regular meetings with clients to review financial and operational results and prepare strategic M&A related performance and to develop strategic, M&A related plans.
Collaborate with and attend meetings with lawyers, bankers, investors, wealth advisors, and other advisors, as required.
Identify competitive dynamics, industry trends, and key performance indicators on both a macro and micro level specific to the target market.
Prepare and review technical analysis, financial projections, forecasts and models.
Design and develop high-quality deliverables including engagement letters, reports, investment memoranda, presentations and correspondence.
Manage engagement economics, including planning, scheduling, budgets, budgets, WIP, billing, and collection.
Identify innovative ways to deliver added value to clients; ensure client needs are met and relationships grow and develop.
Maintain high quality standards and apply specialized knowledge to anticipate, identify and address issues or key risks relevant to the client’s business.
Actively network in the local business community, consider business development opportunities, and lead the preparation and delivery of competitive proposals.
Mentor, motivate, and coach team members towards professional and personal development by setting clear expectations, providing feedback and conducting performance reviews.
Maintain flexibility to travel, as required.

Skills And Experience

Master’s degree in a related field is considered an asset
CPA designation
CBV or CFA designation is considered an asset
5 to 6+ years of professional services experience in M&A or corporate finance
Experience in the transaction advisory services sector assisting clients with due diligence services relating to merger, acquisition or capital raising efforts
Extensive experience in financial analysis and modeling
Experience in business and practice development
Strong communication, management, relationship building, and leadership skills

MyRewards@MNP

With a focus on high-potential earnings, MNP is proud to offer customized rewards that support our unique culture and a balanced lifestyle to thrive at work and outside of the office. You will be rewarded with generous base pay, vacation time, 4 paid personal days, a group pension plan with 4% matching, voluntary savings products, bonus programs, flexible benefits, mental health resources, exclusive access to perks and discounts, professional development assistance, MNP University, a flexible ‘Dress For Your Day’ environment, firm sponsored social events and more!

The annual salary range for this position is: $90,000–$140,000.

Diversity@MNP

We embrace diversity as a core value and celebrate our differences. We believe each team member contributes unique gifts and amplifying their potential makes our business stronger. We encourage people with disabilities to apply!

jobs.title: Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture
jobs.description:
McKesson, l’une des 10 premières entreprises du classement Fortune Global 500, touche à pratiquement tous les aspects des soins de santé et s’emploie à faire une réelle différence. Nous sommes reconnus pour notre capacité à offrir un savoir, des produits et des services qui rendent les soins de qualité plus accessibles et plus abordables. Chez nous, la santé, le bonheur et le bien-être de nos gens et des personnes que nous desservons sont prioritaires—et nous tiennent à cœur.

Ce que tu fais chez McKesson a de l’importance. Nous favorisons une culture où tu peux t’épanouir et avoir un impact, et où tu es encouragé à proposer de nouvelles idées. Ensemble, nous façonnons l’avenir de la santé pour nos patients, nos communautés et nos équipes. Si tu souhaites dès aujourd’hui contribuer à la santé de demain, nous aimerions avoir de tes nouvelles.

McKesson is an impact-driven, Fortune 10 company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. We are known for delivering insights, products, and services that make quality care more accessible and affordable. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care.

What you do at McKesson matters. We foster a culture where you can grow, make an impact, and are empowered to bring new ideas. Together, we thrive as we shape the future of health for patients, our communities, and our people. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you.

Directeur(trice) principal(e) de l’architecture de solutions/Senior Director, Solution Architecture

À propos du poste

McKesson recherche un(e) Directeur(trice) Principal(e), Architecture d’Entreprise et Expérience Numérique
pour diriger la stratégie d’architecture couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation des solutions héritées (legacy) et la gestion de l’expérience numérique. Ce leader définira la vision de solutions technologiques modernes, évolutives, sécurisées et centrées sur le client afin de soutenir les priorités de l’entreprise et d’améliorer les résultats opérationnels.

Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez les pratiques d’architecture qui relient la stratégie d’affaires à l’exécution technologique. Vous collaborerez avec les dirigeants, les équipes produits, ingénierie, sécurité, opérations et les parties prenantes métier afin de moderniser les plateformes, simplifier les environnements hérités, orienter la stratégie d’expérience numérique et renforcer la gouvernance architecturale. Vous développerez également les talents, influencerez les décisions à l’échelle de l’entreprise et aiderez les équipes à livrer des solutions technologiques à fort impact dans un environnement complexe et réglementé.

Ce que vous ferez

Diriger la pratique d’architecture d’entreprise couvrant l’architecture de solutions, l’architecture applicative, la modernisation et la gestion de l’expérience numérique.
Définir les normes d’architecture, les feuilles de route, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres décisionnels permettant une livraison technologique sécurisée et évolutive.
Collaborer avec les dirigeants et les responsables métier afin d’aligner la stratégie d’architecture sur les objectifs d’affaires, les besoins des clients et les priorités de l’entreprise.
Diriger les stratégies de modernisation des applications et plateformes héritées, y compris la rationalisation applicative, la migration vers le cloud, l’intégration, l’automatisation et la réduction de la dette technique.
Orienter l’architecture de l’expérience numérique afin d’améliorer l’utilisabilité, l’accessibilité, la performance, la fiabilité ainsi que les parcours clients et employés de bout en bout.
Conseiller les équipes sur les modèles d’architecture modernes, notamment les API, les microservices, les plateformes cloud natives, l’intégration de données, la gestion des identités, la sécurité et l’observabilité.
Superviser la planification du portefeuille d’architecture, la stratégie fournisseurs, les recommandations d’investissement et la création de valeur mesurable.
Développer les responsables et les équipes d’architecture grâce au mentorat, à la gestion des talents, à l’évaluation de la performance et à un leadership inclusif.

Exigences de base

13 ans ou plus d’expérience professionnelle en technologie, dont au moins 6 ans dans des fonctions de leadership en architecture, ingénierie, livraison d’applications, plateformes numériques ou transformation technologique.
Diplôme universitaire en informatique, systèmes d’information, ingénierie ou domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
Expérience dans la direction d’architectures d’entreprise, de solutions ou applicatives dans des environnements technologiques de grande envergure.
Expérience de la conception et de la modernisation d’architectures de solutions d’entreprise en s’appuyant sur des plateformes intégrant l’intelligence artificielle et des technologies émergentes afin de stimuler l’innovation, l’évolutivité et la création de valeur.
Expérience dans l’élaboration de stratégies d’architecture, de feuilles de route, de normes, de modèles de gouvernance et de recommandations destinées aux dirigeants.
Expérience dans la modernisation d’applications, de plateformes ou de capacités numériques héritées.
Expérience en gestion de responsables, d’équipes d’architecture ou d’équipes technologiques multidisciplinaires.
Expérience de collaboration avec des parties prenantes métier et technologiques de haut niveau pour influencer la stratégie et l’exécution.
Expérience en planification budgétaire, gestion des fournisseurs, priorisation de portefeuille ou prise de décisions d’investissement technologique.

Compétences et expériences privilégiées

Expérience avec les plateformes cloud, les stratégies API, les microservices, l’architecture événementielle (event-driven), le DevSecOps ou l’ingénierie de plateformes.
Expérience en gestion de l’expérience numérique, plateformes d’expérience client, portails, applications mobiles/web ou solutions omnicanales.
Expérience dans les secteurs de la santé, de la distribution pharmaceutique, de la chaîne d’approvisionnement, du commerce de détail ou d’autres environnements d’entreprise réglementés.
Expérience des cadres d’architecture d’entreprise, des comités de revue d’architecture, de la modélisation des capacités ou de la gestion de portefeuille applicatif.
Expérience de direction de programmes de transformation à grande échelle impliquant plusieurs équipes, fonctions ou unités d’affaires.
Excellentes compétences en communication avec les dirigeants et capacité à simplifier des décisions technologiques complexes pour des audiences métier.
Capacité démontrée à améliorer la performance opérationnelle, réduire la dette technique et accélérer la mise sur le marché.
Style de leadership axé sur la collaboration, la vision stratégique, la conduite du changement, l’orientation client et le développement des talents.

Déplacements, présence au bureau et exigences physiques

Le modèle de travail peut être à distance, hybride ou en présentiel selon les besoins de l’entreprise et de l’équipe.
Des déplacements occasionnels peuvent être requis pour des réunions de leadership, des sessions de planification, des rencontres avec des fournisseurs ou des activités de collaboration d’équipe.
Le poste requiert une utilisation régulière de l’ordinateur ainsi qu’une participation à des réunions virtuelles et en personne.

__________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

About The Role

McKesson is seeking a Senior Director, Solution Architecture
to lead architecture strategy across solution architecture, application architecture, legacy solution modernization, and digital experience management. This leader will set the vision for modern, scalable, secure, and customer-centered technology solutions that support enterprise priorities and improve business outcomes.

In this role, you will lead architecture practices that connect business strategy to technology execution. You will partner with senior leaders, product, engineering, security, operations, and business stakeholders to modernize platforms, simplify legacy environments, guide digital experience strategy, and strengthen architecture governance. You will also develop leaders, influence enterprise decisions, and help teams deliver high-impact technology solutions in a complex, regulated environment.

What You’ll Do

Lead the enterprise architecture practice across solution architecture, application architecture, modernization, and digital experience management.
Define architecture standards, roadmaps, governance models, and decision frameworks that enable scalable and secure technology delivery.
Partner with executive and senior business leaders to align architecture strategy with business objectives, customer needs, and enterprise priorities.
Lead legacy application and platform modernization strategies, including rationalization, cloud migration, integration, automation, and technical debt reduction.
Guide digital experience architecture to improve usability, accessibility, performance, reliability, and end-to-end customer and employee journeys.
Advise teams on modern architecture patterns, including APIs, microservices, cloud-native platforms, data integration, identity, security, and observability.
Oversee architecture portfolio planning, vendor strategy, investment recommendations, and measurable value delivery.
Build and develop architecture leaders and teams through coaching, talent planning, performance management, and inclusive leadership practices.

Basic Requirements

13+ years of professional technology experience, including 6+ years of leadership experience in architecture, engineering, application delivery, digital platforms, or technology transformation.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience.
Experience leading enterprise, solution, or application architecture across large-scale technology environments.
Lead the design and modernization of enterprise solution architectures, leveraging AI-enabled platforms and emerging technologies to drive innovation, scalability, and business value.
Experience developing architecture strategy, roadmaps, standards, governance, and executive-level recommendations.
Experience leading modernization of legacy applications, platforms, or digital capabilities.
Experience managing leaders, architecture teams, or cross-functional technology teams.
Experience partnering with senior business and technology stakeholders to influence strategy and delivery.
Experience with budget planning, vendor management, portfolio prioritization, or technology investment decisions.

Preferred Skills/Experience

Experience with cloud platforms, API strategy, microservices, event-driven architecture, DevSecOps, or platform engineering.
Experience with digital experience management, customer experience platforms, portals, mobile/web applications, or omnichannel solutions.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical distribution, supply chain, retail, or other regulated enterprise environments.
Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks, architecture review boards, capability modeling, or application portfolio management.
Experience leading large-scale transformation programs across multiple teams, functions, or business units.
Strong executive communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technology decisions for business audiences.
Demonstrated ability to improve operational performance, reduce technical debt, and increase speed-to-market.
Leadership approach aligned to collaboration, strategic insight, change leadership, customer focus, and talent development.

(Procédés, Méthodes, Outils, Données) pour rejoindre notre équipe Performance et Amélioration opérationnelle basée à Mirabel (Québec, Canada), où vous travaillerez conjointement avec les èquipes de la VSM, de transformation et de Toulouse en assurant la livraison end-to-end de toutes les versions PMTD industrielles pour atteindre la préparation des capacités VSM à travers toutes les fonctions.

Vos Défis:

Architecturer la feuille de route PMTD industrielle intégrée pluriannuelle en définissant la portée et la structure de toutes les versions;
Agir en tant que tour de contrôle PMTD industrielle, en synchronisant la livraison entre tous les flux et parties prenantes fonctionnelles (EU/CAN);

Assurer la livraison end-to-end de toutes les versions PMTD industrielles pour répondre aux défis du programme StepX;
Gérer l'exécution directe d'un budget de coûts non récurrents (NRC) de plus de 20 M$.

Votre Profil:

Vous avez un baccalauréat / diplôme universitaire ;
Vous avez au moins 15 ans d'expérience pertinente ;
Vous détenez une certification en gestion de projet (Project Management) ;

Vous avez la capacité à travailler avec une autonomie complète et à exercer une influence stratégique/transversale.

Ce travail nécessite une prise de conscience liée à tous les risques potentiels de conformité et à un engagement à agir avec intégrité, ces valeurs sont le fondement du succès, de la réputation et de la croissance durable de l'entreprise.

jobs.title: Research Director, IT Financial Management
jobs.description:
Position Purpose

The ITFM (IT Financial Management) practice helps IT leaders around the world answer a hard question with evidence: how does our technology spend compared to our peers, and where should we improve? As Research Director, you own the delivery of Infotech's flagship IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking service - the engagements that put that evidence in front of CIOs and CFOs.

You will provide experience-based benchmarking insight and guidance that helps IT leaders drive measurable results, maintaining an active pulse on the needs of Members located globally and staying current on industry developments so you can deliver exceptional service across calls and benchmark engagements - in collaboration with analysts, Research Directors, and colleagues across the Research Division.

This is a senior, client-facing advisory role. While it is not a formal people-management position, you set the standard the wider ITFM analyst team works to, and your judgment shapes how the benchmarking service itself evolves.

Our promise to you

You will work for a rapidly growing company that understands the importance of supporting employees through flexibility, inclusiveness, learning and development, internal career mobility, measurement of the Employee Experience and actioning on employee feedback, and building strong relationships.

What You Will Do, Includes, But Not Limited To

Lead ITFM Benchmarking engagements

Lead and deliver ITFM’s flagship offering - IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking engagements with analyst support.
Act as a trusted guide for C-suite clients in IT Financial Management, sharing insight on how to manage costs better and lessons from their industry on improving IT’s cost-to-value through benchmarking.
Improve the benchmarking service through your expertise — new ways of representing data and new opportunities to enhance the insights delivered.
Keep a pulse on industry trends and best practices in your areas of expertise, contributing ideas that shape the benchmarking service.

Cross Departmental Collaboration & Support

Support Call Advisory, Workshops, and Global Services teams by advising peers on IT Spend and Staff Benchmark research and analysis as needed.
Provide subject-matter expertise and feedback to other Research Division teams and to partnering divisions — Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, and others — as needed.
Design and build high-quality keynote and other presentations and deliver them successfully as needed.

Practice & Analyst Development

Contribute to and help with own benchmarking methodology, mapping standards, and delivery toolsets, working with Research Directors and the Practice Lead.
Support automation and data infrastructure initiatives that improve engagement consistency and scalability.
Mentor Research Analysts, reviewing their benchmark outputs and client-ready materials and helping them progress toward independent engagement leadership.
Make active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analysis, research, and writing workflows, and help bring effective practices to the wider team.

Required

What you’ll need to succeed:

Undergraduate degree required (business or technology preferred).
Practical experience (5–10+ years) in one or more of: IT Cost Benchmarking, IT Financial Management, or Project Management.
Experience in project-driven environments.
Presentation and facilitation experience demonstrated through prior client-facing engagements.
Eligibility to obtain appropriate work authorization for cross-border engagements within North America.
Availability for periodic after-hours work to support APAC-based client engagements.

Strongly Preferred

History of gaining and maintaining trusted-advisor status with management; strong working relationships with the C-suite.
Experience leading teams, given the advisory nature of the services offered (this is not a formal people-management role).
Professional certifications in Finance and Accounting, Project Management, Business Analysis, or other related disciplines.
Active use of AI productivity tooling (e.g., Claude, Copilot) in analytical, research, or writing workflows.

Assets

MA, MBA, or MSc.
Experience with ERP or financial systems as cost data sources (SAP, Oracle, Workday, Dynamics, etc.).
Prior experience contributing to cross-departmental initiatives (e.g., Sales, Public Relations & Marketing, Global Services).

Visa Requirement:
Must be eligible to obtain appropriate work Visa for cross-border work within North America and globally.

Work Hours Requirements:
Must be available for after-hours work periodically to service APAC clients.

Language Skills:
Bilingual proficiency in French, Spanish or German is preferred to support our diverse client base across North America and globally.

Skills & Attributes

Client Interaction & Facilitation - Leads calls and benchmark engagements with C-suite Members; facilitates discussion and builds trusted-advisor standing.
Benchmarking & Cost Analysis - Deep working knowledge of IT Spend and Staffing Benchmarking methodology, cost frameworks, and peer set construction.
Project Management - Manages engagement timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder expectations across concurrent client benchmarks.
Business Development - Identifies and helps develop opportunities to grow the benchmarking service and its value to clients.
Executive Writing & Presentation - Produces and delivers polished, executive-ready written analysis, decks, and keynote presentations.
AI Productivity Tooling - Practical use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate analysis, research, and writing. A working habit, not a credential.
Inclusion - Works effectively and respectfully with a globally distributed team and Member base.
Knowledge Application & Decision Making - Applies sound problem-solving and judgment in ambiguous, data-light situations.
Managing Through Change & Uncertainty - Stays effective and credible as client needs, data, and priorities shift.
Dynamic Learning Mindset - Keeps a pulse on industry trends and brings new thinking back into the practice.
Mentorship & Collaboration - Reviews and improves analyst work and shares knowledge proactively across the team.

Responsibilities

Lead the proposal, planning and execution of corporate finance engagements, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and capital-raising transactions.
Manage end-to-end M&A processes, including market research, target identification, buyer outreach, negotiations, and transaction execution.
Lead the delivery of private placement and syndication of financing, including debt, junior capital, and equity.
Conduct regular meetings with clients to review financial and operational results and prepare strategic M&A related performance and to develop strategic, M&A related plans.
Collaborate with and attend meetings with lawyers, bankers, investors, wealth advisors, and other advisors, as required.
Identify competitive dynamics, industry trends, and key performance indicators on both a macro and micro level specific to the target market.
Prepare and review technical analysis, financial projections, forecasts and models.
Design and develop high-quality deliverables including engagement letters, reports, investment memoranda, presentations and correspondence.
Manage engagement economics, including planning, scheduling, budgets, budgets, WIP, billing, and collection.
Identify innovative ways to deliver added value to clients; ensure client needs are met and relationships grow and develop.
Maintain high quality standards and apply specialized knowledge to anticipate, identify and address issues or key risks relevant to the client’s business.
Actively network in the local business community, consider business development opportunities, and lead the preparation and delivery of competitive proposals.
Mentor, motivate, and coach team members towards professional and personal development by setting clear expectations, providing feedback and conducting performance reviews.
Maintain flexibility to travel, as required.

Skills And Experience

Master’s degree in a related field is considered an asset
CPA designation

5 to 6+ years of professional services experience in M&A or corporate finance
Experience in the transaction advisory services sector assisting clients with due diligence services relating to merger, acquisition or capital raising efforts
Extensive experience in financial analysis and modeling
Experience in business and practice development
Strong communication, management, relationship building, and leadership skills
